Application Data.NAME: Bicycle Haven Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bicycle Haven Inc. specializes in the retail sale and service of bicycles, offering a wide range of high-quality bicycles, accessories, and repair services. Our operations include a well-secured storefront with alarm systems and surveillance cameras to ensure the safety of our products and customers. We focus exclusively on selling manufacturer-approved bicycles and components, avoiding rental or loaner bike programs to minimize liability exposure. Our service department provides maintenance and repairs using certified parts, and we engage in community-oriented events such as cycling safety workshops, employing strict risk management protocols. Additionally, we prioritize employee training and theft prevention measures to safeguard our inventory and enhance customer trust.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Bicycle Haven Inc. does not own or operate any other businesses beyond its primary location at 123 Main Street, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62701-1234.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, Bicycle Haven Inc. experienced a theft incident where a high-value electric bicycle, valued at $2,500, was stolen from the storefront due to a broken lock. The incident was reported to the police and is currently under investigation. The claim is pending resolution. Additionally, on 06/10/2022, a customer was injured in the store due to a slip and fall resulting from a spilled drink caused by an employee. The related medical expenses amounted to $2,500, and the claim has been settled.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the storefront, 24/7 video surveillance system, and hired security personnel during high-traffic events.
